description: Answer-bearing verbatim anchors into the 23 RFCs of the `rfc` corpus. Strings that span a hard line break in the RFC's 72-column layout are written on one line here; every gate compares whitespace-normalised text, which is also how eval/run_eval.py scores chunk relevance.

facts.expected: default value of 3 is assumed (indicating a multiplier of 8).
facts.summary: An absent ack_delay_exponent is taken to be 3, i.e. ACK Delay scales by 8.

facts.summary: The advertised active_connection_id_limit may not be below 2.
